note: Which building produces which unit. Every unit in data/units.json appears exactly once (tests/gallery/production.test.js). art: game = drawn by src/render/buildings.js, concept = gallery/structure-art.js. A unit a lab adds to another building is listed under the lab. HQs build each faction's own infantry (the soldier is shown).

buildings.name: HQ
buildings.blurb: Each faction builds its own infantry here, as many as it can pay for (all nine are shown; a faction builds only its own).

buildings.name: Garage
buildings.blurb: Light wheeled vehicles and the mechanic who fixes them.

buildings.name: Chemical Plant
buildings.blurb: Flames and rockets; the mine layer only if the plant has a pier on the water.

buildings.name: Tank Factory
buildings.blurb: Armour and the anti-tank infantry that walks beside it.

buildings.name: Support Factory
buildings.blurb: Medics, supply trucks and troop carriers: the support that keeps an army moving.

buildings.name: Artillery Range
buildings.blurb: Indirect fire: mortar teams and the big guns.

buildings.name: Agency
buildings.blurb: Snipers and the eyes of the army.

buildings.name: Shipyard
buildings.blurb: Divers and the surface fleet, from destroyer to carrier.

buildings.name: Harbor
buildings.blurb: Small boats: gun boats and troop transports.

buildings.name: Airfield
buildings.blurb: Copters and the light aircraft, plus the RPG trooper who shoots at them.

buildings.name: Airbase
buildings.blurb: Fighters, bombers and the SAM launcher that defends them.

buildings.name: Hover Lab
buildings.blurb: A lab: owning it adds hover craft to the factory and harbor menus.

buildings.name: Stealth Lab
buildings.blurb: A lab: owning it adds stealth units to the factory and airbase menus.

buildings.name: Heavy Lab
buildings.blurb: A lab: owning it adds the heaviest hulls to the factory, shipyard and airfield menus.

buildings.name: Missile Lab
buildings.blurb: A lab: owning it adds missile units to the factory and sub pen menus.

buildings.name: Engineer Works
buildings.blurb: Gear on the front and stacked wall blocks: the fixed defences and walls.
